name: Binokel
summary: German-Swiss melding and trick-taking card game where players bid for extra cards and race to 1,500 points.
rules_text: Play with 48 cards (two short German packs, A-10-K-O-U-7). Deal 15 cards each 3-handed with a 3-card dabb, or 11 each 4-handed in teams with 4-card dabb. Auction: players bid expected points from melds+tricks, highest bidder takes dabb, discards same number, chooses trump, optionally calls a card. If hand is hopeless bidder may go out choosing a trump to minimize loss, losing bid value. Then melding: declarer first. Score for Binokel (Q of Spades + J of Diamonds), pairs K+O same suit, four of a kind, family A-10-K-O-U of trump etc. Cards may be reused across melds. Melds only count if you win a trick. Then play tricks anticlockwise with Farbzwang, Stichzwang, Trumpfzwang. Points for tricks plus melds added, rounded to 10. If declarer fails to make bid, bid deducted; else bid and points kept. First to >=1500 after a deal wins.
rating_reason: Specific trick-taking game with team variant, hidden hands
